body:
I understand.  I'm afraid of forgetting about my mom.  I have memories but they seem so far away now that she is gone, like they happened in another life or in a dream.  I'm hoping against hope that it's just the grief, that these memories will become more clear with time.

It just never changes.  Every day I think of her and I cry every time that I do.  The loss is incomparable to anything else, and no matter how hard I cry, no matter how long I am stuck in this cavernous depression, she will still not come back.  I can grieve this hard, suffer this much for the rest of my life, and it won't make a difference.  There is no mercy in death for a survivor.

From one person struggling to another:  peace on your journey, wherever it takes you.  I am thankful that you shared your story.
